condition: Bound assumes the fixed integer-shift forward bins and reverse fit use the same aligned 24M pixel correspondence domain; equal counts alone do not establish per-pixel membership.
conclusion: Existing evidence does not justify treating highlight/out-of-range values as the sole cause or relaxing thresholds. Even in-range unfitted samples include residual mismatches. Next diagnostic should attribute post-fit residuals per aligned pixel and range class in both directions.
limits: Arithmetic analysis of retained logs only. No new decoding run, production change, independent camera qualification or accepted-match claim.
